programmes.d: Miguel is suing his friend of 30 years because he believes the defendant is the cause of his dog's death.
David is suing William after testifying for him in criminal court, and wants to be paid the wages he's owed.
Heather is suing her mother because after she bred her dog, her mother gave two of the puppies to her sister to sell.
Sabrina is suing her child's father after claiming he threw a man-tantrum and broke their son's tablet.
Ashley is suing her former friend, Terra, for not returning her dog after caring for it while she was in rehab.
After Billie's puppy died 6 days after purchase, she demands the seller reimburse her for vet bills, pain and suffering.
Michael is suing Brian for the cost to bail him out of jail but Brian said it was his girlfriend who called for help.
Jamal says he's suing jealous ex-girlfriend for trying to run him over after accusing him of cheating on her.
Tyra is accusing her friend since highschool of allowing her car to be towed and junked due to a parking ticket dispute.
Arthur is suing his ex-fiancé for the price of her engagement ring after she refused to return it.
Christina is suing someone she's known for 8 years over money she claims he owes her for a French bulldog.
Linda claims her daughter is lying about her being a bad mother, so she's suing for defamation.
Lynn believes his wife was cheating on him throughout their relationship, now he's here to be paid back for a loan.
Irma demands a refund for the party bus she rented from LaToya, stating it wasn't decorated properly.
Trudy is suing bar owner Jefferey for damages because she claims a drunk patron plowed into her parked car.
Eleanor believes that the defendant may be the daughter of her brother, who has been deceased for 18 years.
Bruce says he thought he purchased a real taxidermy sail fish but says Michael fooled him into buying a plastic toy.
Wilda is suing her neighbor for the cost of stolen speakers and $3,000 for harassment.
Corina broke up with Anthony after choking her but after finding out she's pregnant, is suing for child support.

David is suing John after he was unable to get the car registered because he claims the title wasn't notarized.
McKenzie is suing her baby's father for the price of a car because he chooses work and football over the family.
Kathy is suing truck driver Doug for vehicular damages after claiming he illegally passed her on the right.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
Tajanea is suing her ex-boyfriend for over $2,000 after she claimed he damaged her car and apartment.
